messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected for org:aurelia-bank on dedicated-us-west-2 pool. Rolling error spike 2025-03-21 10:00 UTC. Paging oncall.

oncall-erin: ack paging. I'm booting up. Can someone drop initial impact stmt for Aurelia? @cs-liaison-raj, @acct-tech-lead-zoe pls.

sre-miguel: I'm seeing 502s from inference-proxy -> runtime nodes. Traces point to connection refused to worker after OOM kill. Investigating; grabbing logs now.

engineer-chen: logs show repeated 'OOMKilled' on worker 10.12.5.23 and subsequent connection resets. I'm draining that node and restarting containers.

oncall-erin: thanks. Miguel, is this customer-isolated or platform-wide?

sre-miguel: initial filter by org shows ~95% of error traces are from aurelia-bank prefixes. Other tenants are largely unaffected. Recommend treating as Aurelia enterprise-impacting incident (Sev2).

acct-tech-lead-zoe: Aurelia escalation contacts (from contract):
- Primary: Lina Ortega (SRE Lead) — pager +1-415-555-0178 — lina.ortega@aurelia-bank.com
- Secondary: Mark Hale (Platform Ops) — mark.hale@aurelia-bank.com
- CSM: Priya Sengupta — priya@redwood.com
Routing rule: Page primary + CSM immediately; if no ack in 15m, escalate to secondary; email execs after 30m.

cs-liaison-raj: drafting customer-facing message now. Suggested non-technical impact line:
"Hi Lina — we’re aware some of your API requests to our hosted inference endpoints have returned errors since 10:00 UTC. We’ve applied a mitigation (routing traffic to a compatible fallback model) to restore service. You may see slightly different response latency and formatting; we’re actively working on a permanent fix and will update you." 

ops-manager-lina: prepare statuspage entry and mark as 'Identified'. Severity: Sev2 (single enterprise degraded). Use 30min update cadence. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-20250321-2746 created; severity=Sev2; owner=oncall-erin. Private statuspage draft: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20250321-2746 (internal preview)

oncall-erin: immediate mitigation plan: 1) drain failing node 10.12.5.23, 2) spin new replica, 3) route Aurelia traffic to fallback pool (compat-model-quantized). Chen, please run fallback routing and confirm.

engineer-chen: running fallback command now:
```
redwood route set --org aurelia-bank --from model=gpt-3.5-open-v2 --to model=gpt-3.5-compat-fallback --weight 100
```
Applying... done. Verified requests are being served from fallback nodes.

sre-miguel: monitoring: 502 rate for Aurelia decreased from ~22% -> ~2% in 4 minutes after routing. Latency increased ~50ms but successful responses are returning. Good stopgap.

cs-liaison-raj: customer message (finalized) — sent at 10:12 UTC:
"Hi Lina — we’re aware of degraded responses for your API calls since 10:00 UTC. Our engineers have routed traffic to a compatible fallback model to restore service; you may see slight changes in response latency and response format. We are actively remediating the root cause and will follow up with a full post-incident summary. If you’d like an incident bridge now, please let us know. — Priya, Redwood"
(Sent via email + DM to Lina + CC Priya)

incident-bot: Pagerlog: page sent to lina.ortega at 10:11 UTC; escalation timer set to 30m.

ops-manager-lina: note on customer comms: tailor the follow-up to Aurelia execs with measured impact metrics (error %, duration, mitigations applied). If >60m without full restore, escalate to Sev1 and schedule bridge with Aurelia CTO/CISO.

engineer-chen: started rolling patch to raise JVM heap limits and added a graceful oom hook to reduce hard kills. Patch rollout in progress (batch of 3 nodes).

oncall-erin: Handoff plan: I’ll be on this for next 30m, then handoff to @sre-oncall-nora at 10:40 UTC. Nora — please join the incident channel and pick up monitoring + customer comms after 10:40.

sre-oncall-nora: ack, joining. Please leave a brief summary at handoff with links to logs and the statuspage draft.

cs-liaison-raj: statuspage update (posted 10:15 UTC):
```
Aurelia Bank — Partial degradation (service degradation affecting Aurelia Bank API requests).
Status: Identified
Impact: A subset of Aurelia requests may experience 5xx errors or increased latency.
Mitigation: Traffic routed to a compatible fallback model; error rate greatly reduced.
Updated: 2025-03-21T10:15:00Z
Next update: 2025-03-21T10:45:00Z
```

oncall-erin: brief internal exec template posted in #exec-briefs channel:
```
Short: Aurelia Bank experienced degraded inference (Sev2). Mitigation: traffic routed to fallback model; error rate reduced 22%->2%. Root cause under investigation (OOM on worker nodes). ETA for full restore TBD. CSM Priya is coordinating customer updates.
```

ops-manager-lina: good. Raj — after the 30m window please prepare a short timeline and preliminary RCA points for Aurelia's postmortem.

cs-liaison-raj: will do. Timeline + sent messages + links will be in the incident doc.

sre-miguel: logs and current graph links:
- Error rate dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/err/aurelia-502s
- Worker logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/query?node=10.12.5.23

oncall-erin: closing loop: current state = mitigated on fallback; monitoring continues. Next update/handoff at 10:40 UTC to @sre-oncall-nora. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Handoff scheduled at 2025-03-21T10:40:00Z to sre-oncall-nora. Next expected update 10:45 UTC.

sre-oncall-nora: handoff ack. Summary from Erin preserved; taking over monitoring and customer comms. Starting 10:40 UTC.
